public_rationale: The public-message mismatch holds: Anthropic acknowledged that landing-page and documentation changes confused people outside the experiment. The assertion of uniformity does not hold: contemporaneous reporting found a product page still offering Pro access. Neither finding disproves the company's stated experiment size.
limitations: The counterexample relies on contemporaneous firsthand reporting because a sufficiently complete archived product page was not recovered.
Reading 'all' loosely would soften the contradicted portion.
Public messaging and actual subscriber access are different questions.

our_interpretation: Assess the factual claim about public documentation and its mismatch with the stated test scope; the expression of dissatisfaction is evaluative.
The relevant period is the April 21 episode before the public changes were reversed.
Public documentation shown outside the test cohort can establish confusing messaging without disproving the reported enrollment percentage.
The word 'all' asserts uniformity across relevant support and website pages.
criteria.support_condition: Contemporaneous records establish broadly visible exclusion messaging despite a narrowly described signup experiment. Full support additionally requires the asserted uniformity across relevant pages.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Contemporaneous relevant pages still advertise Pro access during the episode, contradicting uniformity; or reliable records show the exclusion messaging was confined to the test cohort.
